BODY — Quarter Window Glass

BO-39

6. REMOVE DECK TRIM SIDE PANEL AND SPEAKER BOX
(a) Remove five screws and the deck side trim.
(b) *Remove three screws and the speaker box.

7. REMOVE REAR SHOULDER BELT ANCHOR BOLT AND BELT GUIDE

8. REMOVE ROOF SIDE INNER GARNISH
(a) Remove the screw and the hook.
(b) Remove four screws.
(c) Using a screwdriver, pry the clips and remove the roof side inner garnish.
HINT: Tape the screwdriver tip before use.

9. REMOVE QUARTER WINDOW GLASS MOULDING
(See page BO-27)

10. REMOVE QUARTER WINDOW GLASS
(a) Remove the four upper retainers.

(b) Remove the retainer nuts.

(c) Using piano wire, cut loose the adhesive.
(d) Remove the glass.
NOTICE: Do not damage the clips and the body.
